name: comp-20
blurb: Email input with a download icon button on the right.
description: An email input with a separate button containing a DownloadIcon on the right. Button has background, border, hover, and focus states.
use_when: You need a download or similar action paired with an input, with a more prominent button than comp-19.
avoid_when: The button action conflicts with its visual (download icon on subscribe) or needs custom size.
a11y: Label linked to input. Button has aria-label. Icon marked aria-hidden. Focus management via z-index. Disabled state supported.
